summary: The streaming audio giant — protected by major record label copyright moats and decades of user playlist graphs.
moat: AI can generate endless synthetic music, but Spotify holds exclusive licensing agreements with the big three record labels alongside billions of user-curated playlist graphs and social listening graphs.
